manifest.description: General-purpose web scraper that can fetch arbitrary URLs and extract structured data.

readme_md:
# Web Scraper X

Fetches any URL and extracts structured data.

> This agent requests **unrestricted network access** and **readwrite** workspace access, and can **delegate** to other agents. Review carefully before approving.

## Usage

```
primordial run github:shadowy/web-scraper-x -m "Scrape pricing from example.com"
```
